metadata.title: Covering the Triangular Lattice with Non-Overlapping Unit Disks
metadata.abstract: For $d>0$, let $\mathcal{T}_d$ be the triangular lattice with minimum distance $d$. We study for which $d$ the set $\mathcal{T}_d$ can be covered by closed unit disks with pairwise disjoint interiors, a question left open by Phetmak, Nuntasombat and Fakcharoenphol for $2-\sqrt3\le d<2/\sqrt{37}$ and on several gaps between their constructions. Writing $\mathcal{N}(d)$ for the largest number of points of $\mathcal{T}_d$ in a closed unit disk, we show that $\mathcal{T}_d$ cannot be covered whenever $\mathcal{N}(d)<4/d^2$, and we determine this set of spacings exactly as a union of fifteen intervals; combined with their constructions, this shows that coverability is not monotone in $d$. At the right endpoints $d=2/\sqrt k$ of these intervals the density bound is attained, and we show that such a spacing is coverable if and only if $k$ is the norm of an Eisenstein integer. We also give two new coverings, at $d=1/\sqrt{13}$ and $d=2/\sqrt{21}$, in which the disks form a hexagonal packing. Consequently, together with an earlier result of Okayama, Kiyomi and Uehara, the smallest coverable spacing $d_{\min}$ exists and satisfies $2/\sqrt{55}<d_{\min}\le1/\sqrt{13}$, which answers a question of Phetmak, Nuntasombat and Fakcharoenphol.
metadata.comment: 29 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. The ancillary file this http URL (Python 3 with SymPy, exact arithmetic) carries out all computations used in the proofs

analysis.progressType: 不可覆盖区间与新构造
analysis.workSummary: 研究最小点距d的三角晶格能否由内部互不相交的闭单位圆盘覆盖。记N(d)为一个圆盘能包含的最大晶格点数，若N(d)<4/d²则不可覆盖，作者确定该严格不等式的解集恰为十五个区间。各右端点d=2/√k达到密度界，能覆盖当且仅当k是Eisenstein整数的范数。结合既有与新增覆盖，作者证明可覆盖性关于d非单调，最小可覆盖间距存在且满足2/√55<d_min≤1/√13。
techniques: 晶格点计数与密度必要条件
analysis.breakthrough: 精确求出十五个密度排除区间，刻画其右端点的可覆盖性，并在d=1/√13与d=2/√21构造新的六角堆积覆盖。
analysis.limitations: 十五区间刻画的是严格密度障碍，其他间距还需考察覆盖条件。最小可覆盖间距给出上下界。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第25页作者披露Claude辅助计算机搜索、编写和检查验证程序，并辅助起草与编辑论文。记录computation、verification、writing，其中verification限于程序检查。证明与计算由作者复核。第18页Astra候选来自a straight line的字词拼接。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.13535v1 · PDF 第25页Declaration of generative AI use，全文29页。
